csv_project_name: CMAR For Two Auxiliary Building Additions
csv_scope_of_work: Aux. Bldg. Addition #121: Located east of Loop 494 and on the north side of Farris Green Road, in Porter, Texas, the development of a pre-engineered metal structure with 1,700 sq. ft. interior space and 917 sq. ft. covered patio. Project also includes concrete, site work and storm drainage. The layout will be designed to accommodate two (2) logistics shops, climate-controlled storage and an office. Aux. Bldg. Addition #122: Located east of FM 1314 and on the south side of Rolling Hills Dr, in Porter, Texas, the development of a 3,600 sq. ft. pre-engineered metal structure for covered parking. Project also includes concrete, site work and storm drainage. The layout will be designed to accommodate five (5) parking lanes with lights, power drops and air reels.
